text: 10 OVERDOSAGE No cases of overdosage have been reported in patients with Cushing's disease receiving SIGNIFOR subcutaneously. Doses up to 2.1 mg twice a day have been used in healthy volunteers with adverse reactions of diarrhea being observed at a high frequency. In the event of overdosage, it is recommended that appropriate supportive treatment be initiated, as dictated by the patient's clinical status, until resolution of the symptoms. Up-to-date information about the treatment of overdose can be obtained from a certified Regional Poison Center. Contact Poison Control (1-800-222-1222) for latest recommendations.
